build_system: pnpm workspaces, pytest for Python tests, turbo for monorepo orchestration
test_framework: pytest for Python (unit and integration tests), vitest for TypeScript
verification_instructions: Run pytest after each wave completion. Integration tests require TEST_DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL environment variable and Docker Compose test database on port 55432.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None - evidence files in .agents/evidence/ are append-only and not checked into git
environment_constraints: Integration tests skip gracefully when TEST_DATABASE_URL_TUTORIAL not configured. Never mutate production databases (tutorial_prod, neon-prod). All database operations during verification must use disposable test databases.
contribution_requirements: Fail-closed design mandatory: BLOCKED/SKIPPED never resolve to PASS. Evidence ledger is append-only (never truncate). All agents must log to evidence ledger. Sequential execution with explicit dependencies. Hash-bound artifacts for tamper detection.
key_patterns: Existing agent registry in app/orchestration/agent_registry.py defines 15 agents. Agent coordinator in app/orchestration/agent_coordinator.py routes execution. Evidence ledger in app/evidence/ledger.py provides append-only JSONL writers. Persistence layer in app/persistence/ uses SQLAlchemy async with optimistic locking.
directory_structure: services/project-ai/ contains app/ (source code) and tests/ (pytest tests). app/ has orchestration/ (agent registry and coordinator), evidence/ (ledger system), persistence/ (database models), and workflows/ (task-specific modules). Evidence files live in .agents/evidence/ at repo root. Agent implementations follow async def execute_{agent_name}(context: AgentContext) -> AgentResult pattern.
